name: The Highwayman
source:
This is the story of one fateful day in the life of Bess, the innkeeper's daughter. She has three men in her life: the romantic Highwayman, the rough-and-ready captain, and the sweet Ostler. Who is she working with? The choice is yours. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20115]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是旅店老板的女儿贝丝一生中决定命运的一天的故事。她的一生中有三个男人：浪漫的拦路强盗、粗暴的船长和甜蜜的奥斯特勒。她和谁一起工作？选择权在你。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20115]引理软论坛[/url]]
